title: Does "Buy now, pay later" services affect your credit score? Here's what to know.
summary: Local TV segment on how BNPL providers' credit-reporting plans are changing and what that means for scores.

assertions.quote: we told you back in May affirm one of the big ones. They started doing that
when you open multiple accounts in a relatively short period, typically your credit score goes down

verdicts.note: Standard credit-scoring models penalize several new accounts opened in a short window, and BNPL's six-week structure can trigger that.

assertions.quote: nearly half of buy now pay later users say they have experienced at least one financial problem with these services

verdicts.note: A Bankrate survey found close to half of buy now pay later users reporting at least one of these problems.
